title: coleus achankoviliensis
intro: Coleus achankoviliensis, commonly known as Veldtkampongs plant, is a species of flowering plant in the family Lamiaceae. This plant is used in traditional Ayurvedic medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Coleus achankoviliensis include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve cognitive function, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant activities.
